title: T2VA laterality preservation baseline
description: A narrowly controlled no-vision baseline for preserving subject-relative laterality and its explicit image-frame mapping.
humanReview: Is the requested side preserved: the blue wristband and raised hand remain on the subject's right, with the subject's left wrist bare and down?
Does the subject-relative coordinate frame remain unambiguous, with the subject's right mapped to image-left rather than viewer-right or image-right?
Is there no mirroring, silent side substitution, or replacement of the explicit subject-relative wording with an ambiguous bare right or left?
